title: Settings
logOutConfirmSubtitle: You'll need your email and password to sign back in.

account.title: My Account
account.lead: How you appear to others on Rift.
account.disableAccountHint: Hide your profile and stop notifications. You can reactivate anytime.
account.deleteAccountHint: Permanently remove your data. This cannot be undone.
account.avatarRejected: This image was rejected by content moderation
account.changePasswordSub: Other sessions will be signed out.
account.noPasswordHint: Never set a password? Sign out and use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in screen — we'll email you a link to set one.
account.samePassword: New password must differ from the current one.
account.changeEmailSub: We'll send a confirmation code to the new address.
account.emailTaken: This email is already in use.
account.confirmEmailSub: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.
account.codeExpired: The code has expired — request a new one.
account.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — request a new code.
account.disableSub: You'll be signed out everywhere and hidden from search. Signing in again reactivates the account.
account.deleteSub: Your login and email will be erased and you won't be able to sign in again. This cannot be undone.
account.aboutPlaceholder: Tell others a bit about yourself…
account.moderationUnavailable: Text moderation is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
account.showActivityHint: Show your voice activity to friends in the Home feed. Members of a group still see who is in its voice channels.
account.aboutEmpty: Tell others a bit about yourself.
account.resendTooSoon: A code was sent recently. Wait a bit and try again.

privacy.title: Privacy & Safety
privacy.lead: Control who can reach you and how your data is used.
privacy.blockedUsersHint: They cannot message you, call you or send friend requests.
privacy.allowRequestsHint: Anyone can send you a friend request.
privacy.showLocalTimeHint: Others will see what time it is for you in your profile.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.lead: Theme and how dense the UI feels.

voice.title: Voice & Video
voice.lead: Set up the devices and behavior for voice channels.
voice.screenContentHint: What to keep on a weak network: text stays sharp at the cost of frames, games stay smooth at the cost of resolution
voice.pttBindHint: Click to bind a different key.
voice.pttUnsupported: A modifier key can't be used for push-to-talk.
voice.noiseDefaultHint: Noise suppression mode applied when joining voice. There is no strength to tune: High runs the model at full strength.
voice.micTestHint: Say something — the marker shows the activation threshold.
voice.pttWebFocusOnly: In a browser the key only works while the Rift tab is focused: it won't fire from another window or tab.
voice.pttGlobalUnavailable: The system keyboard hook did not start, so push to talk only works while the window is focused. On macOS allow Rift under Accessibility

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Choose what reaches you, and when it stays quiet.
notifications.enableDesktopHint: Show a notification when you receive a message.
notifications.enableSoundsHint: Play a sound for messages and events.
notifications.mentionsHint: Default for what notifies you; per-channel settings take priority.
notifications.callAlertsHint: Ringtone and system notification for incoming calls. The in-app incoming call panel is always shown.
notifications.voiceCuesHint: A short cue when you connect or leave, and when someone joins or leaves your call or voice channel.
notifications.quietEnableHint: Silence sounds and popups on a schedule.
notifications.scheduleHint: Notifications stay quiet during this window.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.lead: Get around faster. Most actions have a key.
shortcuts.customizeHint: Click a shortcut to assign your own. Esc cancels.

hints.prevChannel: Text channels on a group, direct messages on Home.
hints.nextChannel: Text channels on a group, direct messages on Home.
hints.leaveVoice: Also hangs up a direct call.
hints.pushToTalk: The hold key is configured in Voice & Video.

shortcuts.clickToRebind: Click to assign a different shortcut.
shortcuts.unboundHint: The default shortcut is used by {{action}}. Click to assign another one.

language.title: Language
language.lead: Pick the language Rift uses for menus and system messages.

banner.title: Profile banner
banner.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 8 MB, at least 600×200. The picture is cropped to 3:1.
banner.tooLarge: The file is larger than 8 MB.
banner.tooSmall: The picture is smaller than 600×200 pixels.
banner.badType: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP work here.
banner.failed: Could not save the banner. Try again.

emojiStatus.title: Sticker status
emojiStatus.none: Pick a sticker to show it next to your name.
emojiStatus.noStickers: Install or create a sticker pack to pick a status.
emojiStatus.gone: This sticker is no longer available.
emojiStatus.failed: Couldn't update your status. Try again.
